title: iPhone held by fix-rest-script, unused for 5 min while 2 jobs wait

messages.text:
fix-rest-script has held the iPhone lease for 5 min without a phone run (iphone.mjs run, scroll, record or gesture; since 08:20Z, last phone run of fix-rest-script). The limit is 5 min.
Queued for it: cd-roll-ca, fix-nav-morph.
fix-rest-script: run your phone part now, or release the lease (node tools/lock.mjs release iphone --owner fix-rest-script) so the next one can start, or say here why it waits. Desk (mgmt-ops-10): please make sure the phone is used.
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the phone is used again or released (tools/idle.mjs, I-105, I-111).
